name: Hőgyész (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a light blue stripe along each side edge, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Hőgyész (a blue and green shield with a white fox, a crescent and a bough) below the name HŐGYÉSZ in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
